claims.statement: paths-ignore suppresses a run only when every changed path matches an ignore pattern; any unmatched path triggers even when other paths are ignored. The docs/** example concerns the root docs directory, not every nested directory named docs.

Include and ignore path keys cannot coexist for one event. Negative include patterns require a positive pattern; negative matches remove earlier inclusion and later positives re-include. The sub-project example excludes its docs subtree but a simultaneous eligible source change still triggers.

No changed files means no filtered run. PR file lists use three-dot comparison against the last base synchronization; existing-branch pushes compare head/base using two dots and new-branch pushes use the specified ancestor-parent base.

Pushes exceeding 1000 commits or diff-generation timeout always trigger. Changed-file lists exceeding the version-dependent actions-paths-filter-limit bound (3000 when enabled, otherwise 300) can miss matching files beyond the returned prefix and fail to trigger. More-specific filters or simpler diffs are proposed mitigations, not proof of exhaustive matching.
